class: request validators in the bench (endpoint.py, virtual_bench*.py), the logical models (virtual_*_model.py, virtual_core.py) and the independent checkers (conformance_*.py): later copies of a tag validated like the first, an unknown critical TLV refused unsupported with the received tag before side effects, malformed vs unsupported vs unavailable, refusal payload tags, the core §4.3 order, and checkers that demand one reason where several apply

divergences.spec: TLV 0x05 reset（critical: `channel(u16)、hold_ms(u16)`）... hold_ms は core の max_op_ms の対象。 / core §7.5: 明示的な待ちの引数がこれを超える要求は rejected unsupported / core §2.3: 後続の同じtagも上の検証対象である。
divergences.fix: a reset TLV whose hold_ms exceeds max_op_ms is refused unsupported with that copy's tag as received (0x85 / 0x05), the first copy and every later one, before anything is touched (was: only the channel was checked; a 65535 ms hold was taken)

divergences.spec: core §4.3: | 0x01 | unknown_function | その fn は無い（見出しの fn、または payload で指す fn） | / 順 4: ... 対応（unknown_function: payload で指す fn が無い。 ...）... を、何も変える前にすべて確かめ、当たった理由のどれか 1 つで断る。 (capture §4.1: tracksに無いfnはunsupported（固定部分の印0）)
divergences.fix: a bind naming an fn the probe does not have (0x7777) may be answered unknown_function or unsupported 0x00 + fn TLV; the checker accepts either, state unchanged (was: unsupported required); fn 1 (an fn that is not a track) still requires unsupported
